number-of-steps-to-reduce-a-number-to-ze.notes: Halve when even, subtract 1 when odd. O(log n) time, O(1) space. Loop-free: popcount(n) + bit_length(n) - 1.

subtract-the-product-and-sum-of-digits-o.notes: Peel digits with n % 10, drop them with n / 10. Loop runs once per digit, so O(log n), not O(n). Product starts at 1, sum at 0.
